The '''Separatist flagship deck cannon''' was a twin-barreled combination of a [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] and an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] that was utilized aboard the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].
